items.title: Mistral Advances AI for Engineering with NVIDIA
items.en_title: Mistral Advances AI for Engineering with NVIDIA
items.en_oneliner: Mistral and NVIDIA are joining forces on next-generation AI-native engineering workflows, powered by NVIDIA's accelerated computing.

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.en_title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI and Google Cloud are teaming up to bring frontier models and Codex workflows into Gemini's Model Garden, available via Google Cloud Marketplace.
